title: pm-dispatch: reserve the contract-review tier for the skills seat and the spec seat’s clause-② review; default tier elsewhere; the director’s tier is the maintainer’s per-summon choice
body:
Fixes #17285

Model-tier policy after this PR: the contract-review tier is reserved for the skills seat (the three clause-① protocol files plus the published `skills/**` catalogs) and for the spec seat's clause-② review; the triage seat and every other execution seat run the default tier and spawn no contract-review-tier subagent; adjudication (decision inbox, 代裁, 一类自裁) belongs to the maintainer-summoned director seat alone, at whatever tier the maintainer summons it — no tier hard gate. The seat's own prose uses the tier names the skill text already uses (契约复审档 = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, 默认判断档 = `TIER_DEFAULT`); no model name enters any skill file, and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` stays the single value site of the constant (self-test pinned).

## 裁决 — the maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (chat, 2026-09-10)

1. 「现在所有车道都会派 fable 任务，没有fable就等契约复审，你综合评估一下，我们哪些车道实际需要fable级别的开发的。哪些只用opus就够了」
2. 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」
3. 「按照你的新建议，只有 spec 和 skills 车道需要fable 对吧。」 — the seat answered 对 with the split in the table below, and the maintainer built rulings 4 and 5 on that answer.
4. 「分诊席现在也是opus，裁决统一由我以总监的身份召唤。比如我在 hotcrm 或其他元数据项目中可以召唤总监裁决。」
5. 「现有的卡片如果写了要求fable的，也要让相关的项目经理知道，opus就够了。」
6. 「裁决（决策箱、代裁、一类自裁）是人工召唤，不需要fable，简单的元数据项目opus就可以，这个我人工判断。」 — added 2026-09-10T03:16Z (card comment 5612109163) while this branch was already in flight; the coordinator relayed it the same minute and the branch carries the amended shape (details under Acceptance notes).

## What the rule text says after this PR

| seat / channel | build | review | contract-review tier used |
|---|---|---|---|
| triage seat, incl. its emergency-triage subagent | — | — | never |
| engine / services / cli / devx / ui / hotcrm execution seats | default tier | the lane seat's own default-tier review + the gates | never |
| spec seat | default tier | clause-② PRs: contract-review-tier review (in-seat subagent; fuse unchanged) | review only |
| skills seat | contract-review tier for the clause-① files AND the published `skills/**` catalogs; default tier for `references/**` and other governed one-liners as today | skills-seat self-review at the contract-review tier | build + review |
| adjudication: decision inbox, 代裁, 一类自裁 | — | — | the maintainer-summoned director seat, and only it, at the tier the maintainer chooses per summon (ruling 6); no tier hard gate, no 免档整理 state |

Seat reading recorded for veto: 「分诊席现在也是opus」 is read as covering the whole triage seat including its emergency-triage subagent (SKILL.md :332 below). If the maintainer meant the direct session only, that one line reverts.

## Every changed line, before → after, next to the ruling it implements

Line numbers are on `origin/main` at `ebf9a489`; identical to the card's `d64bcb63` on this surface (`git log d64bcb63..ebf9a489` over the five files is empty). Every rewritten line was measured at ≤120 bytes, the ratchet's line cap.

### `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` — tier constants, their docblock, the tier rendering, the self-test

- `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` gains `{ glob: 'skills/**', tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, why: 'clause ① (2026-09-10 ruling, verbatim 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」): the published catalog ships verbatim to third parties by npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills and npm create objectstack, so a wrong edit is installed elsewhere before anyone here reads it — and no one-line exemption applies under this root', oneLineExit: false }` — ruling 2. `oneLineExit: false` is the one path-shaped exit the ruling closes (a closed enumeration beats a per-line "is this mechanical" call); every other entry carries no flag (self-test pinned as an opt-out).
- Docblock: the clause-① set now names the published `skills/**` catalog (ruling 2); the clause-② paragraph says default-tier build, contract-review-tier REVIEW in the spec seat only, other lanes' review = own default-tier review plus gates, triage and director spawn no contract-review-tier subagent (rulings 1, 3, 4, 6); the sanctioned-exits paragraph states the encoded `skills/**` exception; the measured-side-effect paragraph adds the re-measured count (47 tracked files under `skills/` on `ebf9a489`, one already covered); the authority paragraph cites the 2026-09-10 widening.
- `deriveTier` copies `oneLineExit` onto each hit; `tierLines` renders the exits line without the one-line-class exit when any hit carries `oneLineExit: false` (「⛔ NOT available for this surface … carries no one-line exemption」), and otherwise exactly as before. The two clause-② sentences of the rendering now say 「owes a contract-review-tier REVIEW too (spec seat; default-tier build)」 instead of 「is fable-mandatory too」 — the stale wording would have restated the superseded review scope in every claim comment.
- Self-test: 15 new cases — the pure derivation (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, a generated `references/_index.md` under a published skill, the published PM skill covered by two entries at ONE tier, `skills/**` not reaching `.claude/skills/**`, the flag as data, the rendering with and without the exit, a mixed surface losing the exit for the whole card) and the CLI end to end (`--tier skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` and `--tier skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` print the mandate naming `'skills/**'` and refuse the exit; `--tier .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/core-rules.md` prints no mandate).
- ⛔ Not touched: how dispatch-gates resolves a literal or a base (STAGE-THEN-RUN, #14290 is not addressed here — see Acceptance notes), `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS`, `TIER_FLOOR`/`TIER_DEFAULT`, the constant's value.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

把「谁用契约复审档」从「所有车道都派、没有就等复审」收窄为两处:skills 席(三个协议文件加对外发布的 `skills/**`,施工与复核都用)与 spec 席的条款②复核。分诊席、engine/services/cli/devx/ui/hotcrm 执行席全部默认判断档,不再起契约复审档子代理。裁决(决策箱、代裁、一类自裁)只由您召唤的总监席出,档位由您逐场按项目定,不设档位硬门、不再有「不达档只整理不裁」的状态;分诊席不再有每 fire 代裁通道,置信门由五条改四条。`dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `--tier` 推导把 `skills/**` 整根列入强制档,并明确对它没有一行级豁免。

### 为什么改
